reviews.topic: ADR 0168 / ADR 0777 NoZoom and NoRotate view adjustment
current_code: ViewGeometry::adjustment is anchored at the upper-left default-user-space corner (min x, max y), uses page.rotate for inverse rotation, and scales by reciprocal logical magnification only for screen interpretation.
draw_annotation applies the adjustment to the whole appearance before the page base transform, matching §12.5.5's explicit whole-annotation sentence.
The page reports view-dependence for NoZoom so zoom can re-interpret, while NoRotate depends on the file's /Rotate and is not separately view-dependent.
reviews.decision: ADR 0168's central architecture premise remains valid: /Rotate is document geometry and NoZoom is the view-dependent case. Existing named tests support each flag independently. A combined AP Matrix/BBox pixel test is a targeted missing composition assertion; no runtime failure observed.
reviews.scope_boundary: §12.5.3 names rotation by changing the page dictionary's Rotate entry. A host rotation independent of /Rotate is not established by this cited requirement. The public model currently passes Page.rotate, not an arbitrary viewport rotation.
reviews.source_basis: Primary Table167 physical486/471; following prose physical487/472; appearance algorithm physical489/474. Parent corrected draft locators.
